browser_tokens_scope_xor.name: browser_tokens_scope_xor
browser_tokens_scope_xor.value:
("browser_tokens"."scope_kind" = 'run' and "browser_tokens"."run_id" is not null and "browser_tokens"."session_id" is null)
        or ("browser_tokens"."scope_kind" = 'session' and "browser_tokens"."session_id" is not null and "browser_tokens"."run_id" is null)

cli_sessions_token_iff_issued.name: cli_sessions_token_iff_issued
cli_sessions_token_iff_issued.value: ("cli_sessions"."status" in ('active', 'revoked')) = ("cli_sessions"."token_hash" is not null and "cli_sessions"."expires_at" is not null)

mcp_servers_tool_kind_fields.name: mcp_servers_tool_kind_fields
mcp_servers_tool_kind_fields.value: "mcp_servers"."kind" = 'mcp' or ("mcp_servers"."command" is null and "mcp_servers"."args" is null and "mcp_servers"."url" is null)

mcp_servers_tool_credential.name: mcp_servers_tool_credential
mcp_servers_tool_credential.value: "mcp_servers"."kind" = 'mcp' or ("mcp_servers"."auth_type" = 'none' and ("mcp_servers"."kind" <> 'postgres' or "mcp_servers"."credential_secret_id" is not null))

mcp_servers_identity_transport.name: mcp_servers_identity_transport
mcp_servers_identity_transport.value: "mcp_servers"."identity_secret_name" is null or (length(btrim("mcp_servers"."identity_secret_name")) > 0 and ("mcp_servers"."kind" = 'openapi' or ("mcp_servers"."kind" = 'mcp' and "mcp_servers"."transport" in ('http', 'sse'))))

oauth_tokens_code_fields.name: oauth_tokens_code_fields
oauth_tokens_code_fields.value: ("oauth_tokens"."kind" = 'code') = ("oauth_tokens"."code_challenge" is not null and "oauth_tokens"."redirect_uri" is not null)

runs_ended_after_started.name: runs_ended_after_started
runs_ended_after_started.value: "runs"."ended_at" is null or "runs"."started_at" is null or "runs"."ended_at" >= "runs"."started_at"

triggers_kind_shape.name: triggers_kind_shape
triggers_kind_shape.value:
("triggers"."kind" = 'webhook' and "triggers"."secret_hash" is not null and "triggers"."cron" is null and "triggers"."timezone" is null)
        or ("triggers"."kind" = 'schedule' and "triggers"."secret_hash" is null and "triggers"."cron" is not null and "triggers"."timezone" is not null)

workspace_principals_source_xor.name: workspace_principals_source_xor
workspace_principals_source_xor.value:
("workspace_principals"."kind" = 'membership' and "workspace_principals"."membership_id" is not null and "workspace_principals"."api_key_id" is null)
        or ("workspace_principals"."kind" = 'api_key' and "workspace_principals"."api_key_id" is not null and "workspace_principals"."membership_id" is null)
